blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent embodied systems increasingly build on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for their pretrained understanding and reasoning capabilities, but their perception of the physical world remains largely limited to basic modalities such as vision and audio. However, broadening MLLMs to more diverse sensory modalities from the physical environment is challenging: their representations are often weakly connected to the MLLM and vary substantially in structure and statistics, while their interpretation still requires shared high-level understanding and reasoning. We therefore propose Unisense, a unified embodied MLLM framework that supports diverse physical sensory modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. Unisense follows a two-stage training process: (i) aligning sensory representations with language to establish a language-accessible interface; and (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the shared LLM to provide specialized processing for different sensory modalities. To support broad sensory learning, we curate Unisense-1M, a large-scale embodied sensory training corpus comprising 1M samples across 8 sensory modalities. We further evaluate Unisense on 12 benchmarks spanning depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell understanding. Across these heterogeneous sensing tasks, Unisense achieves strong performance and outperforms both generalist and specialized models on most benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of pretrained MLLMs as unified models for embodied sensory understanding.
blocks.zh: 最近体现的系统越来越多地以多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)为基础,使其具备事先经过培训的理解和推理能力,但它们对物理世界的看法在很大程度上仍局限于视觉和音频等基本模式。 然而,将MLLMs扩大到来自物理环境的更多样化的感官模式具有挑战性:其表达方式往往与MLLM联系薄弱,在结构和统计上差异很大,而其解释仍需要共同的高层理解和推理. 因此,我们提出Unisense,这是一个统一的、包含的MLLM框架,在共同的多模式结构中支持各种物理感官模式。 Unisense遵循两阶段培训流程:(一)使感官表达方式与语言相配合,以建立语言可访问的界面;(二)在共享LLM范围内调换模式特定专家,为不同的感官模式提供专业处理. 为了支持广泛的感知学习,我们管理Unisense-1M,这是一个由8个感知模式的1M个样本组成的大规模内含的感知训练体. 我们进一步评估Unisense在深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热能、雷达、运动和嗅觉理解等12个基准上的情况。 在这些多种多样的感知任务中,Unisense在大多数基准上都取得了强大的性能并超越了通论模型和专门模型,显示出预先训练的MLLMs作为体现感觉理解的统一模型的潜力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is reshaping Embodied AI, driving a growing line of generalist embodied models that harness MLLMs’ multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities for physical-world perception and interaction. Representative systems such as PaLM-E ( Driess et al., 2023 ) , RoboBrain ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025a ) , RynnBrain ( Dang et al., 2026 ) and Vesta ( Bjorck et al., 2026 ) demonstrate the potential of this paradigm. However, while modern MLLMs have developed strong capabilities across modalities such as images, video, and audio, their support for diverse physical signals remains limited.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)的迅速进步正在重新塑造精密的AI,驱动着越来越多的泛泛论模型,这些模型利用MLLMs的多模式理解和推理能力进行物理世界感知和互动. PaLM-E(Driess等人,2023年),RoboBraine等代表系统 (Ji等,2025;Cao等,2025a.),RynnBrain(Dang等,2026.)和Vesta(Bjorck等,2026.)证明了这一范式的潜力. 然而,虽然现代的MLLMs在图像、视频和音频等各种模式中发展出强大的能力,但它们对各种物理信号的支持仍然有限。

blocks.en:
The real world contains rich information that can be captured by embodied sensory modalities, such as depth, thermal, tactile, and radar.
These modalities provide complementary physical cues about geometry, contact, temperature, and dynamics beyond basic modality inputs.
As Figure 1 illustrates, such cues can clarify physical states that remain ambiguous in basic observations.
Accordingly, recent work has explored three main strategies for incorporating sensory modalities into language-centric models. (i) Specialists develop dedicated interfaces or adaptation mechanisms for individual sensory modalities ( Li et al., 2025d ; Lai et al., 2026 ; Asif Imran Shouborno et al., 2025 ) . (ii) Binders ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) use image or language representations as semantic anchors to align different modalities within a shared representation space. (iii) Generalists ( Han et al., 2024 ; Moon et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) integrate multiple modalities through modality-specific encoders, projectors, or routing modules.
Despite these differences, most sensory modality adaptation is still concentrated at the modality interface, before entering the LLM.
A more detailed discussion of related work is provided in Appendix § A .
blocks.zh:
真实世界中包含着丰富的信息,可以通过包含的感官模式来捕捉,如深度,热能,触觉和雷达等.
这些模式在几何、接触、温度和动态方面提供了超出基本模式投入的补充物理提示。
如图1所显示,这种提示可以澄清基本观察中仍然模糊不清的物理状态。
因此,最近的工作探讨了将感官模式纳入以语言为中心的模式的三个主要战略。 (一)专家为个人感官模式制定专用接口或适应机制(李等,2025d;赖等,2026;阿西夫·伊姆兰·肖博诺等,2025) (二)宾德尔斯(Girdhar等,2023;朱等,2024)将形象或语言表现作为语义锚地,在共享代表空间内调和不同模式. (三)通论者(Han等,2024;Moon等,2024;Wu等,2024;Zhang等,2025b)通过模式特有编码器,投影器,或路由模块来整合多种模式.
尽管有这些差异,大多数感官模式的适应仍然集中在模式界面,然后才进入LLM.
关于相关工作的更详细讨论载于附录§A。

blocks.en:
This emphasis largely reflects the maturity gap in modality interfaces between embodied sensory and widely studied basic modalities.
On the one hand, the latter benefit from well-established modality-specific encoders, web-scale multimodal data, and widely adopted alignment recipes ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Chu et al., 2024 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , whereas many embodied sensory modalities still lack comparable resources, making sensory–language grounding a primary challenge.
On the other hand, despite heterogeneous low-level representations, these modalities ultimately rely on shared high-level understanding and reasoning, motivating a unified LLM backbone.
For basic modalities, mature interfaces have further enabled omni-modal models to move beyond and introduce modality-dependent computation within the LLM ( Li et al., 2025c ; Inclusion AI, 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ) .
For embodied sensory modalities, such LLM-side specialization remains limited: existing methods largely share the same parameters across representations with substantially different structures, statistics, and spatiotemporal characteristics. Prior studies suggest that such parameter sharing across modalities or tasks can introduce conflicting learning signals ( Chen et al., 2024c ; Liang et al., 2025 ; Hao et al., 2026 ) .
We therefore view unified embodied sensory modeling across two levels: semantic grounding at the modality–language interface, followed by computational specialization within the shared LLM.
blocks.zh:
这种强调在很大程度上反映了所体现感官和被广泛研究的基本方式之间模式界面的成熟性差距.
一方面,后者受益于既定的特定模式编码器、网络规模的多模式数据和广泛采用的配对方法(Radford等,2021年;Chu等,2024年;Tschannn等,2025年),而许多体现的感官模式仍然缺乏可比较的资源,使感官语言成为首要挑战。
另一方面,尽管低层次代表情况各不相同,但这些模式最终依赖于共同的高级别理解和推理,从而推动统一的LLM主干网。
就基本模式而言,成熟的界面使全方位模式模式进一步超越并引入了LLM范围内的依赖模式的计算(Li等,2025c;Collection AI,2025;Shukor等,2025.).
对于体现的感官模式,这种LLM-侧专门化仍然有限:现有方法在结构、统计和时空特征大相径庭的表达方式上基本具有相同的参数。 先前的研究表明,这种跨模式或任务的参数共享可能引入相冲突的学习信号(Chen等,2024c;Liang等,2025;Hao等,2026)。
因此,我们从两个层面看待统一的体现感官模型:语义定位在模式-语言界面上,然后在共享LLM内进行计算专业化。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present UniSense , a unified MLLM for embodied sensory understanding. UniSense supports diverse embodied sensory modalities through lightweight modality tokenizers, a unified encoder, modality projectors, and a shared LLM.
Building on this architecture, UniSense follows a two-stage training process to address the above challenges. (i) Aligning different sensory representations with language through caption supervision, making physical sensory information accessible to the LLM, and then (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the LLM, allowing different sensory modalities to specialize beyond the shared backbone computation.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了UniSense,一种统一的MLLM,用于体现感官理解. UniSense通过轻量级模式活化器,一个统一的编码器,模式投影器,以及共享的LLM,支持多种已体现的感官模式.
在这种结构的基础上,UniSense遵循一个两阶段培训进程,以应对上述挑战。 (一)通过字幕监理,使不同的感官表达方式与语言相配合,使物理感官信息能够被LLM所取取取取,再(二)在LLM内调用特定模式的专家,使不同的感官表达方式在共享主干计算之外能够专业化.

blocks.en:
To support UniSense, we develop a data construction pipeline that applies modality-specific preprocessing to heterogeneous sensory observations and pairs the processed inputs with modality-aware captions and instruction–response pairs.
This results in a large-scale training corpus of 1M samples spanning 8 embodied sensory modalities, alongside general multimodal data. We further evaluate UniSense on 12 benchmarks covering depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell. Experiments show that UniSense outperforms general multimodal and specialized models on most benchmarks.
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We present UniSense , a unified MLLM that supports text, image, video, audio, and diverse physical sensing modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. • We develop a two-stage training strategy that aligns and specializes sensory processing, enabling language-accessible sensory representations and modality-specific specialization within a shared LLM. • We curate UniSense–1M , a multimodal training corpus spanning 8 embodied sensory modalities, and evaluate UniSense on 12 benchmarks for embodied sensory understanding, demonstrating its effectiveness across heterogeneous sensing tasks.
blocks.zh:
为了支持UniSense,我们开发了一个数据构建管道,将特定模式的预处理应用于不同的感官观测,并将处理过的输入与模式感知标题和指令-响应对对。
因此,除了一般的多式数据外,还有1M个样本,包括8个包含的感官模式的大规模培训。 我们进一步评价UniSense的12个基准,包括深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热能、雷达、运动和嗅觉。 实验表明,UniSense在大多数基准上都超过了一般的多式和专用模式。
• 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们介绍UniSense,这是一个统一的MLLM,在一个共同的多模式结构中支持文本、图像、视频、音频和多种物理感知模式。 我们制定两阶段培训战略,使感官处理协调一致并具有专门性,使语言无障碍感官表达和模式专用在共同的LLM范围内实现。 我们管理UniSense – 1M,这是一个涵盖8个包含感官模式的多模式培训机构,并评价UniSense对所体现感官理解的12个基准,以展示其在各种感官任务中的有效性。

blocks.zh: 2.2 示范建筑

blocks.en: 2.3 Sensory Representation Alignment
blocks.zh: 2.3 感官代表协调

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of the sensory representation alignment stage. Conditional captioning provides language-level supervision by decoding the paired caption from sensory representations, while contrastive alignment aligns sensory and caption representations using the first k k LLM layers.
blocks.zh: 图3:感官表示相接阶段概况. 有条件的字幕通过从感官表示中解码成对的字幕来提供语言层次的监管,而对比对齐则使用第一个k k LLM 层来协调感官和字幕表达.

blocks.en:
Unlike basic modalities, which have been well studied, embodied sensory modalities lack comparably mature language-aligned representations, making their physical semantics difficult to ground in the target MLLM.
Prior work aligns heterogeneous modalities in shared embedding spaces ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) , while generative–contrastive frameworks further show that generative supervision and contrastive learning provide complementary semantic signals ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) .
However, such alignment is typically defined outside the representation structure of the target MLLM that ultimately consumes these modality features.
Recent MLLM studies suggest that grounding modality representations toward the pretrained linguistic structure of the target LLM can improve their integration ( Masry et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
与已经得到透彻研究的基本模式不同的是,所包含感官模式缺乏相适应的成熟语言相通的表达,使其物理语义难以被放入目标MLLM.
先前的工作将共享嵌入空间中的多种模式相协调(Girdhar等,2023;Zhu等,2024;Georgerative-contrastic 框架进一步表明,基因监督和对比学习提供了补充语义信号(Yu等,2022;Xiao等,2025)。
然而,这种对齐通常在最终消耗这些模式特征的目标MLLM的表示结构之外被定义.
近期的MLLM研究表明,对目标LLM语言结构进行预先训练的表达方式可以改善它们的融合(Masry等人,2025;Chen等人,2026)。

blocks.en:
To align embodied sensory representations with language, we construct a modality-aware caption for each sensory input that explicitly verbalizes its physical information.
We use each caption to supervise sensory representations in two complementary ways:
conditional captioning encourages sensory representations to retain physical semantics recoverable through the target MLLM’s native language interface, while contrastive alignment uses representations induced by the target MLLM itself to establish explicit sensory–language correspondence.
The overall design is illustrated in Fig. 3 , with examples of modality-aware captions provided in Appendix § E .
blocks.zh:
为了使所体现感官表达与语言一致,我们为每个感官输入构建一个模式感官描述,明确表达其物理信息。
我们使用每个标题来监督感官表达方式,有两个互补的方式:

blocks.en:
The first training stage grounds embodied sensory representations in the language space of the target MLLM.
However, these heterogeneous representations are still processed by the same decoder parameters, which may introduce interference across modalities or tasks ( Shen et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) .
While recent multimodal models introduce modality- or task-specific computation within the backbone ( Li et al., 2025c ; Inclusion AI, 2025 ) , embodied sensory modeling remains largely focused on modality-side adaptation ( Han et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025d ; Zhou and Yang, 2026 ) .

然而,这些多样的表述仍然用同样的解码参数处理,这可能会引入跨模式或任务的干扰(沈等,2024;梁等,2025.).
虽然最近的多模式模型在骨干内部引入了模式或任务特定的计算(Li等,2025c;Infolmation AI,2025),体现的感官模型仍然主要侧重于模式方面的适应(Han等,2024;Li等,2025d;周和杨,2026)。

We therefore introduce modality-specific capacity within the shared LLM, while keeping self-attention shared and specializing only the feed-forward sublayers.
As shown in Fig. 4 , the base FFN remains as the shared transformation, with modality-specific residual experts providing specialized processing.

因此,我们在共同的LLM中引入了特定模式的能力,同时保持自我关注的共享,并且只专门使用饲料推进子层.
如图4所示,基准FFN仍然是共同的转变,具体模式的剩余专家提供专门处理。

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate UniSense on general multimodal tasks and benchmarks spanning 8 embodied sensory modalities. These evaluations examine both its general multimodal capability and its ability to handle heterogeneous physical sensing signals. Unless otherwise specified, higher scores indicate better performance across all reported metrics.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价UniSense的一般多式联运任务和基准,这些任务和基准涵盖8种体现的感官模式。 这些评价检查了它的一般多模式能力和处理各种物理感知信号的能力。 除非另有说明,较高的分数表明所有报告衡量标准的业绩较好。

blocks.en: General Multimodal Understanding. UniSense-9B achieves 83.6 on TextVQA ( Singh et al., 2019 ) and 2466.0 on MME ( Fu et al., 2025a ) , leading the compared models on both benchmarks . It also performs strongly on speech-conditioned image and video understanding (Table 1 ), indicating that sensory training preserves its basic-modality capabilities.

UniSense-9B achieves 70.1 on the SpatialBench ( Cai et al., 2025 ) 4-task aggregate and 80.5 accuracy on RoboSpatial-Home ( Song et al., 2025 ) without benchmark-specific training, surpassing both general-purpose MLLMs and spatial-specialized models.
On ScanQA ( Azuma et al., 2022 ) , UniSense-9B achieves 74.3 CIDEr using point clouds alone, which increases to 99.6 when combined with images, outperforming all compared baselines. This improvement shows that newly introduced sensory inputs can be naturally composed with basic modality observations to exploit complementary geometric and appearance information.

On radar, it outperforms HoloLLM ( Zhou and Yang, 2026 ) in both action recognition and captioning, with a 21.6-point gain in caption METEOR (Table 7(a) ).
On QuAnTS ( Divo et al., 2025 ) , it answers motion questions directly from skeleton sequences, outperforming baselines given ground-truth actions or pretrained action features (Table 7(b) ).

On Octopi ( Yu et al., 2024 ) , UniSense-9B leads on property comparison and superlative selection, reaching 61.9 and 73.4. On Infrared-Benchmark ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) , it reaches 70.2 zero-shot and 89.9 after fine-tuning, outperforming Infrared-LLaVA ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) by 13.6 and 10.9 points. blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We present UniSense, a unified MLLM for understanding diverse embodied sensory signals beyond basic multimodal inputs.
By grounding heterogeneous sensory representations in language and introducing modality-specific processing within the shared LLM, UniSense enables 8 physical sensing modalities to be modeled under a common architecture.
Extensive experiments show that this unified formulation performs strongly across heterogeneous sensory tasks and can effectively integrate sensory signals with existing multimodal inputs.
Taken together, these results suggest that pretrained MLLMs can move beyond serving as interfaces for new modalities, providing a shared foundation for understanding heterogeneous physical signals without treating each modality as an isolated system.
More broadly, our findings point toward embodied multimodal models that share a common reasoning backbone while retaining the specialization required by different sensing processes.
blocks.zh:
我们提出UniSense,这是一个统一的MLLM,用于理解基本多式联运输入之外的各种包含的感官信号。
UniSense通过将各种感官表达方式定位在语言中,并在共享的LLM中引入特定模式的处理,使8个物理感测方式能够在共同架构下被建模。
广泛的实验表明,这种统一配方在各种感官任务中具有很强的性能,能够有效地将感官信号同现有的多模式输入结合起来。
总之,这些结果表明,经过预先培训的MLLM能够超越作为新方式的接口,为理解各种物理信号提供共同的基础,而不将每一种方式视为一个孤立的系统。
更广义地说,我们的调查结果指出了体现的多式联运模式,这些模式具有共同的推理支柱,同时保留不同感知过程所需的专业化。

blocks.en:
Generalist Embodied Models. Recent advances in MLLMs have motivated a growing line of generalist embodied models that leverage pretrained multimodal backbones for unified perception and reasoning in physical environments.
Early systems such as PaLM-E ( Driess et al., 2023 ) demonstrated the potential of integrating embodied observations into large language models, while subsequent models such as RoboBrain ( Ji et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025a ) , RynnBrain ( Dang et al., 2026 ) , and Vesta ( Bjorck et al., 2026 ) further broaden this paradigm across diverse physical-world tasks and environments.
More recent efforts further emphasize spatial-temporal perception and high-level reasoning ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Mo et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) , while benchmarks such as OpenEQA ( Majumdar et al., 2024 ) and FoMER ( Dissanayake et al., 2025 ) reflect the growing focus on embodied reasoning.
In parallel, vision-language-action models map visual observations directly to low-level robot control ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) , targeting action generation rather than the high-level sensory understanding considered in this work.
Despite this progress, these generalist models still rely largely on basic modalities such as vision and audio, and their extensions beyond these modalities are typically restricted to a single additional modality.
Heterogeneous physical signals such as depth, contact, temperature, inertial dynamics, and fine-grained geometry are therefore rarely available to a single embodied reasoner, even though dedicated models exist for many of them individually.

近期的努力进一步强调空间时空感知和高级推理(赵等,2025;莫等,2025;Team等,2025a; 张等,2026a;袁等,2026.),而OpenEQA(Majumdar等,2024.)和FOMER(Dissanayake等,2025.)等基准则反映了对体现推理的日益重视.
同时,视觉-语言-动作模型将视觉观测直接映射到低等机器人控制上(Ghosh等,2024;Black等,2024;Kim等,2025),瞄准动作生成,而不是本作所考虑的高水平感知理解.
尽管取得了这些进步,这些通俗主义模式仍然在很大程度上依赖于视觉和音频等基本模式,其超出这些模式的延伸通常仅限于一种额外的模式.
因此,一个单一的被体现的致因器很少能提供深度,接触,温度,惯性动力学等异质物理信号,即使其中很多个体都有专用模型.

blocks.en:
Heterogeneous Multimodal LLMs. A parallel line of work extends LLMs to increasingly diverse input modalities.
Image-text pretraining first provides a language-anchored semantic space through large-scale cross-modal alignment ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , which subsequent binding-based methods ( Girdhar et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ) reuse as a pivot to align heterogeneous modalities.
Unified multimodal frameworks ( Moon et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) instead attach multiple modality encoders to a common LLM, enabling a broader set of input types and tasks within one framework.
Audio and speech models likewise benefit from large-scale paired supervision, providing mature language-aligned interfaces for acoustic inputs and spoken instructions ( Chu et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Ghosh et al., 2026 ) .
Other works develop dedicated interfaces for individual physical signals, including depth ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Daxberger et al., 2025 ) , point clouds ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) , inertial and time-series data ( Asif Imran Shouborno et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025d ) , touch ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , thermal ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2025b ; Thushara et al., 2026 ) , radar ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Zhou and Yang, 2026 ) , smell ( Zhou et al., 2025b ; Zhou et al., 2025c ) , and motion ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
However, sensory data generally receive far less linguistic supervision than web-scale image-text data, making their physical content difficult to expose fully to language-based reasoning, and each of these interfaces is designed for one modality in isolation.
In contrast, UniSense uses caption-guided supervision to make sensory semantics language-accessible and covers 8 embodied sensory modalities within a single model.

blocks.en:
Multimodal Fusion and Specialization. Beyond modality alignment, multimodal models also differ in how heterogeneous representations are integrated into language reasoning.
Encoder-projector architectures ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Dai et al., 2023 ) typically perform late fusion , offering a simple interface but limiting deeper and fine-grained cross-modal interaction.
A related line of work unifies modalities on the encoder side, reusing a shared encoder or a pre-aligned binding space as a single interface to the language model ( Han et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) , which makes modality extension straightforward but leaves modality-specific structure largely unmodeled.
Native early-fusion models ( Chameleon, 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ) process multiple modalities within a shared representation space, enabling richer interaction but potentially increasing cross-modal interference.
Recent sparse architectures seek a better balance between sharing and specialization: mixture-of-experts methods ( Shen et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025c ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ) introduce specialized expert pathways, with low-rank expert variants ( Chen et al., 2024c ) reducing the cost of such specialization, while Mixture-of-Transformers and related architectures ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) more explicitly decouple modality-specific computation while retaining shared attention.
These mechanisms, however, have been developed primarily for semantically well-aligned modalities such as image, video, and audio.
UniSense instead targets weakly grounded embodied sensory signals, keeping self-attention shared while adding lightweight modality-specific residual experts to selected feed-forward layers.

blocks.en: B.2.1 General Multimodal
blocks.zh: B.2.1 一般多式联运

blocks.en: Following the multimodal initialization pipeline of Zhong et al. (2025) , we first establish the image–speech–text capabilities of UniSense before sensory training. Speech alignment uses Common Voice ( Ardila et al., 2020 ) and LibriSpeech ( Panayotov et al., 2015 ) , comprising approximately 1.19M speech–text pairs. We then perform image–speech–text instruction tuning on a mixture of Lyra-SFT ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) and selected subsets of FineVision ( Wiedmann et al., 2025 ) , containing approximately 3.12M conversations. The mixture consists primarily of Lyra-SFT together with additional FineVision image–text data.
blocks.zh: 在Zhong等人(2025年)的多模式初始化管道之后,我们首先建立UniSense的图像-speech-文本能力,然后进行感官训练。 语音对接使用"共同之声"(Ardila等,2020年)和"LibriSpeech"(Panayotov等,2015年),由约1.19M的语音-文本对组成. 然后,我们对Lyra-SFT(Zhong等,2025年)的混合物和精细视觉(Wiedmann等,2025年)的选定子集进行图像-speech-文本指示调试,其中包含约3.12M的对话。 该混合物主要包括Lyra-SFT和额外的FineVision图像-文本数据。

blocks.en: We evaluate the general multimodal capabilities on image–text, image–speech, and video benchmarks. Specifically, we use TextVQA ( Singh et al., 2019 ) , MME ( Fu et al., 2025a ) , and MMBench ( Liu et al., 2024c ) for image–text understanding; the speech-conditioned variants of TextVQA, DocVQA ( Mathew et al., 2021 ) , and ChartQA ( Masry et al., 2022 ) for image–speech understanding; and Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025b ) and EgoSchema ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ) for video understanding. We follow the standard evaluation protocols for all benchmarks, with Video-MME evaluated without subtitles.
blocks.zh: 我们评价图像文本、图像表达和视频基准的一般多式联运能力。 具体来说,我们使用TextVQA(Singh等,2019年),MME(Fu等,2025年a),MMBench(Liu等,2024年c)来进行图像理解-文本理解;TextVQA,DocVQA(Mathew等,2021年),ChartQA(Masry等,2022年)来进行图像理解-speech理解;Video-MME(Fu等,2025年b)和EgoSchema(Mangalam等,2023年)的语音条件变体来进行视频理解. 我们遵循所有基准的标准评价协议,对视频-MME的评价没有字幕。

blocks.en: B.2.2 Depth
blocks.zh: B.2.2 深度

blocks.en: For depth training, we use SpatialQA ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , SPAR ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , and CA-VQA ( Daxberger et al., 2025 ) . We additionally construct depth-oriented training samples from COCO ( Mishra et al., 2019 ) , Visual Genome (VG) ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) , and SA-1B ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . These datasets cover diverse depth-centric scenes and task formats, including spatial question answering, 3D reasoning, captioning, and general multimodal instruction tuning. We synthesize speech with CosyVoice ( Du et al., 2024 ) for SpatialQA, SPAR, CA-VQA, and part of the constructed depth subset. For samples without depth maps, we generate them using Depth Anything V2 ( Yang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于深度训练,我们使用SpaceQA(Cai等,2025年),SPAR(Zhang等,2026b),CA-VQA(Daxberger等,2025年). 我们还从COCO(Mishra等,2019年),Visual Genome(VG) (Krishna等,2017年)和SA-1B(Kirillov等,2023年)建造了面向深度的训练样本。 这些数据集涵盖了以深度为中心的各种场景和任务格式,包括空间问题回答,三维推理,标题和通用多模式指令调取. 我们与CosyVoice(Du等,2024年)合成了SpaceQA,SPAR,CA-VQA以及所构建的深度子集的一部分的语音. 对于没有深度图的样本,我们使用深度Anything V2(Yang等,2024年)生成.

blocks.en: For sensory representation alignment, each RGB–D sample is paired with a depth-aware description generated offline by Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Xu et al., 2025 ) : the model first extracts objects from RGB and then generates a depth-focused caption conditioned on the RGB image, depth map, and extracted objects.
blocks.zh: 对于感官表达对接,每个RGB-D样本被配对出出由Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct(Xu等,2025年):模型首先从RGB中取出对象,然后生成一个以RGB图像,深度映射,取出对象为条件的以深度为焦点的描述.

blocks.en: We evaluate depth understanding on SpatialBench and RoboSpatial-Home ( Song et al., 2025 ) using paired RGB–D observations. SpatialBench comprises five subtasks: positional reasoning, object existence, counting, reaching, and size comparison. We report each subtask score, together with 4-Task Agg. , the sample-weighted aggregate over Position, Existence, Counting, and Size, and Agg. , the aggregate over all five subtasks. All scores follow the official SpatialBench evaluation protocol. We further construct SpatialBench-Speech by converting the question text into speech to assess the robustness of depth reasoning to spoken queries. For RoboSpatial-Home, we report zero-shot accuracy on the Configuration split without benchmark-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们利用对RGB-D的对等观测,评估对Space Bench和RoboSpatial-Home(Song等,2025年)。 SpaceBench由五个子任务组成:位置推理,对象存在,计数,到达,和大小比较. 我们报告每个子任务的分数,连同4-任务Agg., 样本加权汇总在位置,存在,计数,和大小, Agg., 以及所有五个子任务的汇总. 所有分数都遵循了官方的"空间奔驰"评价协议. 我们通过将问题文本转换成语音来进一步构建Space Bench-Speech,以评估深度推理对口头询问的强性. 对于RoboSpatial-Home,我们报告配置拆分上的零发精度,没有特定基准的微调.

blocks.en: B.2.3 Point Cloud
blocks.zh: B.2.3 点云

blocks.en:
For point-cloud training, we use CLEVR3D-REAL ( Yan et al., 2023 ) , ScanQA ( Azuma et al., 2022 ) , and SceneVerse ( Jia et al., 2024 ) . Together, these datasets cover scene-level descriptions, question answering, and compositional reasoning over indoor 3D scenes. We use the official training splits of ScanQA and CLEVR3D-REAL.
For ScanQA, we further construct RGB-augmented examples using single-view and four-view images from MV-ScanQA ( Mo et al., 2025 ) , yielding both point-cloud-only and point-cloud–image training inputs.
For sensory representation alignment, scene-level descriptions from SceneVerse are matched to ScanQA and CLEVR3D-REAL samples by scene identity.
blocks.zh:
对于点云训练,我们使用CLEVR3D-REAL(Yan等,2023年),ScanQA(Asuma等,2022年)和SceneVerse(Jia等,2024年). 这些数据集共同覆盖了场景级别描述,问答,以及室内3D场景的构成推理. 我们使用ScanQA和CLEVR3D-REAL的官方训练分机.
就ScanQA而言,我们利用MV-ScanQA(Mo等,2025年)的单视图和四视图图像,进一步构建了RGB增强的示例,产生了只用点云和点云-图像培训投入。
对于感官表示对接,来自SceneVerse的场景级别描述通过场景身份与ScanQA和CLEVR3D-REAL样本相匹配.

blocks.en:
We evaluate point-cloud understanding on ScanQA and CLEVR3D-REAL (results reported in Table D15 ), using their official validation splits.
On ScanQA, we evaluate both point-cloud-only ( xyz ) and point-cloud–image ( xyz+img ) inputs. Following the standard ScanQA protocol, we report CIDEr, METEOR (MET.), ROUGE-L (R-L), BLEU-1 (B-1), and BLEU-4 (B-4) for open-ended 3D question answering.
CLEVR3D-REAL evaluates compositional reasoning over point-cloud scenes across existence, counting, comparison, query-attribute, query-object, and compare-attribute questions. We report accuracy for each question category, together with Overall , denoting accuracy over all test questions, and Cls. Avg. , denoting the unweighted average accuracy across question categories.
blocks.zh:
我们利用ScanQA和CLEVR3D-REAL(结果在表D15中报告)的官方验证拆分来评价对这两个系统的点云理解。
在ScanQA上,我们评价了"只点"(xyz)和"正点"(xyz+img)的输入. 遵循标准ScanQA协议,我们报告CIDER,METEOR(MET.),ROUGE-L(R-L),BLEU-1(B-1),和BLEU-4(B-4)的开放式3D问答.
CLEVR3D-REAL评价在全存在,计数,比较,查询属性,查询-对象,比较属性等多个场景之上的构成推理. 我们报告每个问题类别的准确性,以及所有测试问题的准确性,以及Cls. Avg.,说明所有问题类别的未加权平均准确性。

blocks.en:
Figure B6: Overview of the training data composition. The donut charts illustrate the distribution of QA and unique data instances across basic and sensory modalities.
The bottom panel provides a dataset-level breakdown for each modality, with the number of training QA and unique instances reported for every data source.
blocks.zh:
图B6:培训数据构成概况。 甜甜圈图说明了质量保证和独特数据实例在基本和感官模式上的分布情况。
底层面板提供每种模式的数据集级分解,并报告每个数据来源的培训质量保证和独特实例的数量。

blocks.en: B.2.4 IMU
blocks.zh: B.2.4 伊斯兰大学

blocks.en:
For IMU training, we use the SensorCaps and OpenSQA annotations ( Asif Imran Shouborno et al., 2025 ) associated with four human activity recognition datasets: HHAR ( Stisen et al., 2015 ) , MotionSense ( Malekzadeh et al., 2019 ) , Shoaib ( Shoaib et al., 2014 ) , and UCI-HAR ( Anguita et al., 2013 ) .
SensorCaps provides a natural-language description for each IMU window and is used for sensory representation alignment, while OpenSQA provides question–answer pairs covering activity-related understanding and reasoning.
We construct the training and evaluation sets using stratified window-level hold-out within each source dataset, reserving approximately 100 windows per activity class for evaluation and using the remaining windows for training, with no overlap between the two splits.
This results in approximately 23.8k training windows and 2.5k held-out evaluation windows, with multiple OpenSQA questions associated with each training window.
blocks.zh:
对于IMU培训,我们使用与四个人类活动识别数据集相关的Sensor Caps和OpenSQA说明(Asif Imran Shouborno等,2025年):HAR(Stisen等,2015年),MotionSense(Malekzadeh等,2019年),Shoaib(Shoaib等,2014年)和UCI-HAR(Angita等,2013年).
Sensor Caps为每个IMU窗口提供自然语言描述并用于感官表达对接,而OpenSQA则提供问答对接,涵盖与活动相关的理解和推理.
我们利用每个源数据集内分层的窗口级搁置来构建培训和评价集,为评价每个活动类别保留大约100个窗口,并利用其余的窗口进行培训,两个部分之间没有重叠。
这导致大约23.8k培训窗口和2.5k被搁置的评价窗口,每个培训窗口都有多个OpenSQA问题.

blocks.en:
We evaluate IMU understanding as open-ended activity classification on the held-out windows from HHAR, MotionSense, Shoaib, and UCI-HAR, following the LLaSA ( Asif Imran Shouborno et al., 2025 ) classification protocol.
For each dataset, the model is provided with the IMU sequence and generates the predicted class name directly from the input. We report results separately for the four datasets using accuracy and macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1.
blocks.zh:
我们按照LLaSA(Asif Imran Shouborno等,2025年)的分类规程,评价IMU的理解是来自HAR、MotionSense、Shoaib和UCI-HAR的被扣留窗口的开放式活动分类。
对于每个数据集,模型都提供IMU序列,直接从输入中生成所预测的类名. 我们利用精确度和宏观平均精确度、回顾和F1,分别报告四个数据集的结果。

blocks.en: B.2.5 Tactile
blocks.zh: B.2.5 试管

blocks.en:
For tactile training, we use Octopi ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and the Universal Visuo-Tactile Video Understanding corpus (VTBS) ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . Both datasets follow object-level splits, such that objects used for evaluation are excluded from training.
Following the official data generation protocols, we construct 50k instruction–response pairs from each corpus, covering tactile property description, comparison, selection, and object–property reasoning, resulting in approximately 100k training examples in total.
The original GelSight ( Yuan et al., 2017 ) videos are converted into a unified image-based representation by first selecting informative motion frames and then uniformly sampling three RGB frames from each video, which are treated as tactile observations during training.
For sensory representation alignment, we extract the descriptive property text from the generated responses and use it as the corresponding tactile caption.
blocks.zh:
对于触觉训练,我们使用Octopi(Yu等,2024年)和Universal Visuo-Tactile Video Conference (VTBS) (Xie等,2025年). 两个数据集都遵循对象级别划分,这样用于评价的对象就被排除在训练之外.
根据官方的数据生成协议,我们从每个实体中构建出50k指令-应答对,涵盖触觉属性描述,比较,选择,以及对象-财产推理,共产生了约100k个训练实例.
最初的GelSight (Yuan等,2017年)视频被转换为以图像为基础的统一代表,首先选择信息化的动作帧,再从每段视频中统一取样出3个RGB帧,在训练中作为触觉观测处理.
对于感官表达对齐,我们从生成的响应中取出描述属性文本,并将其作为相应的触觉标题.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the official held-out-object splits of Octopi using the same three-frame tactile representation as in training.
Octopi contains 498 questions across property comparison (PC), property superlative selection (PSS), and property–object matching (POM). Following the official protocol, we report accuracy separately for the three tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们用与训练相同的三边触觉代表来评估Octopi的正式被搁置对象。
Octopi包含498个问题,涉及财产比较(PC),财产超选(PSS),以及财产-对象比对(POM). 按照正式协议,我们分别报告三项任务的准确性。

blocks.en: B.2.6 Thermal
blocks.zh: B.2.6 热能

blocks.en:
For thermal training, we use a partial subset of IR-TD from IRGPT ( Cao et al., 2025b ) , the thermal subset of VS-TDX ( Chung et al., 2026 ) , and Infrared-LLaVA ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
Together, these datasets cover thermal captioning, question answering, recognition, counting, and localization.
For IR-TD, we use its caption, instruction-QA, and task-oriented training subsets, and pair thermal images with the corresponding RGB observations when available.
For sensory representation alignment, we use the paired RGB–thermal captions provided by IR-TD.
blocks.zh:
对于热能训练,我们使用来自IRGPT(Cao等,2025年b)的部分IR-TD子集,VS-TDX(Chung等,2026年)和红外-LLAVA的热能子集. (蒋等,2024).
这些数据集加在一起,涵盖热标题,问答,识别,计数,以及本地化.
就IR-TD而言,我们使用其标题、指示-QA和面向任务的训练子集,并在有相应的RGB观测数据时将热成像与配对。
对于感官表达对齐,我们使用由IR-TD提供的配对的RGB-热量标题.

blocks.en:
We evaluate thermal understanding on IF-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) (results reported in Table D14 ), and the Benchmark from Infrared-LLaVA, using thermal inputs for both benchmarks.
IF-Bench is evaluated in a zero-shot setting and groups its tasks into three categories: coarse-grained perception ( Coarse ), fine-grained perception ( Fine ), and image reasoning ( Reason ).
We report accuracy for each of the ten tasks and the overall average.
Infrared-LLaVA Benchmark contains six infrared question-answering tasks covering localization, aerial counting, pedestrian counting, recognition, scene understanding, and safety assessment.
We report the average accuracy across the six tasks under both zero-shot and fine-tuning settings.
blocks.zh:
我们对IF-Bench(Zhang等,2026c)(结果在表D14中报告)和红外-LLaVA基准的热能了解进行评估,同时使用热能输入这两个基准。
IF-Bench在零镜头设定中被评价,并将其任务分为三类:粗糙感知(粗糙感知),细微感知(精细感知)和图像推理(原因).
我们报告这10项任务中的每一项和总体平均数的准确性。
红外线LLAVA 基准包含6个红外问答任务,包括本地化,空中计数,行人计数,识别,场景理解和安全评估等.
我们在零镜头和微调设置下报告六项任务的平均准确性。

blocks.en: B.2.7 Radar
blocks.zh: B.2.7 雷达

blocks.en:
For radar training, we use mmWave point-cloud sequences from MM-Fi ( Yang et al., 2023 ) together with the language annotations introduced by HoloLLM ( Zhou and Yang, 2026 ) . We follow the HoloLLM Cross-Environment protocol, using environments E01–E03 for training and holding out E04 for evaluation, such that the training and test sets contain disjoint environments and subjects.
The training split contains approximately 12.6k temporal radar segments. Based on the HoloLLM action annotations, we construct a mixture of action captions and question–answering examples, and further augment the instruction data with laterality questions and multiple-choice questions targeting confusable action categories, resulting in approximately 121k training examples.
The original HoloLLM captions are further refined offline using GPT-5.1 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) with action labels as guidance. The refined captions are used for sensory representation alignment.
blocks.zh:
对于雷达训练,我们使用由MM-Fi(杨等,2023年)提供的mmWave点-云序列以及由HoloLLM(周和杨等,2026年)介绍的语言说明. 我们遵循HoloLLM跨环境协议,利用E01-E03环境进行培训,并保留E04评估,因此培训和测试集包含脱节环境和课题。
训练分解包含约12.6k个时空雷达段. 基于HoloLLM动作说明,我们构建了动作标题和问答示例的混合,并进一步将指令数据以后起之和多选择问题为对象,针对可交错动作类别,形成约121k个训练实例.
最初的"HoloLLM"标题被以GPT-5.1(OpenAI,2025)为取向而进一步完善出线. 改进后的标题用于感官表达对齐.

blocks.en:
We evaluate radar understanding following the HoloLLM Cross-Environment protocol on the held-out E04 environment. We report results on two tasks using radar-only input: Human Action QA and Action Caption.
For Human Action QA, the model predicts one of the predefined human action categories from the radar sequence, and performance is measured using accuracy following the HoloLLM matching protocol.
For Action Caption, the model generates a free-form description of the observed action, and we report METEOR as the primary metric.
blocks.zh:
我们评价雷达对被搁置的E04环境的超环境协议的认识。 我们只使用雷达输入报告两项任务的结果:人类行动QA和Action Caption.
对于Human Action QA,模型从雷达序列中预测了被预先定义的人类行动类别之一,并且使用HoloLLM匹配协议之后的精度来测量性能.
对于Action Caption,模型生成一个被观测到的动作的自由式描述,我们把METEOR报告为主要度量.

blocks.en: B.2.8 Motion
blocks.zh: B.2.8 动议

blocks.en:
For skeleton-motion training, we use QuAnTS ( Divo et al., 2025 ) , which contains synthetic SMPL ( Loper et al., 2023 ) motion sequences paired with binary, multiple-choice, and open-ended question answering.
We follow the official 80/10/10 trajectory-level split and use only the training partition, corresponding to 24k motion sequences and 120k QA pairs.
For sensory representation alignment, we use the scene-level textual descriptions provided by QuAnTS as auxiliary captions.
blocks.zh:
在骨架-运动训练方面,我们使用QuAnTS(Divo等,2025年),其中含有合成物. SMPL (Loper等, 2023) 运动序列与二进制相配,多选取,并开放问答.
我们遵循80/10/10正式轨迹平面分出,只使用训练分出,对应24k运动序列和120kQA对.
对于感官表示对接,我们使用由QuANS提供的场景级文字描述作为辅助标题.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the official QuAnTS test split, which contains 3k held-out motion trajectories and 15k questions spanning binary, multiple-choice, and open-ended QA. At inference time, the model receives only the skeleton-motion sequence and the corresponding question, without access to scene descriptions or ground-truth action sequences.
We report binary and multiple-choice performance using accuracy and macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1, while open-ended responses are evaluated using ROUGE-L and METEOR.
blocks.zh:
我们评估官方的 QuAnTS 测试分裂, 包含3k 被搁置的运动轨迹 和15k 的问题 跨二进制, 多选择, 和开放式的QA。 在推论时间,模型只接收到骨架-运动序列和相应的问题,没有获得场景描述或地-真实动作序列.
我们利用精确度和宏观平均精确度、回顾率和F1来报告二进制和多选择性能,而使用ROUGE-L和METEOR来评价开放式反应。

blocks.en: B.2.9 Smell

For smell training, we use SmellNet-Base ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , which contains 50 single-substance categories recorded with a six-channel metal-oxide (MOX) sensor array. We follow the official day-wise split, using recordings from the first five days for training and the sixth day for evaluation, yielding approximately 2.5k training windows and 0.5k held-out test windows after temporal segmentation.
We segment the aligned sensor readings into fixed-length windows and normalize each channel using training-set statistics. From these windows, we construct approximately 50.4k instruction samples spanning classification, reasoning, and captioning, and generate temporal descriptions that exclude the substance identity for the alignment stage.
blocks.zh:
为了进行嗅觉训练,我们使用SmellNet-Base(Feng等,2026年),它包含50个用六道金属-氧化物(MOX)传感器阵列记录的单物质类别. 我们遵循按日划分的正式做法,使用头五天的录音进行培训,第六天的录音进行评价,在时间划分后产生大约2.5k个培训窗口和0.5k个被搁置的测试窗口。
我们把对齐的传感器读取分入固定长度的窗口,并使用培训数据集的统计数据使每个通道正常化。 从这些窗口中,我们构建了大约50.4k的指令样本,涵盖分类、推理和标题,并生成时间描述,排除了配合阶段的物质特性。

blocks.en: We evaluate on the held-out day-6 split of SmellNet-Base (502 windows across 50 classes), using training-set normalization statistics. Given a sensor sequence and the full candidate set, the model predicts the substance name; we report Acc@1 and macro F1.
blocks.zh: 我们利用培训组合的正常化统计数据,对SmellNet-Base(50个班级的502个窗口)的搁置日-6分期进行评估。 考虑到传感器序列和完整的候选集,模型预测物质名称;我们报告Acc@1和宏F1。

blocks.en: Appendix C Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: C.1 Baselines
blocks.zh: C.1 基线

blocks.en: We compare UniSense with three groups of baselines: (i) closed-source models , including models from the GPT, Claude and Gemini families; (ii) general multimodal models , such as the Qwen-VL and InternVL families; and (iii) modality-specialized models designed for specific sensory modalities or tasks. For each benchmark, we follow its standard evaluation protocol and report the corresponding metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们比较UniSense与三类基线:(一) 封闭源模型,包括来自GPT、克洛德和双子座家族的模型;(二) 一般多模式模型,如Quen-VL和InternVL家族;以及(三) 为特定感官模式或任务而设计的模式专用模型。 对于每个基准,我们遵循其标准评价规程并报告相应的衡量标准。

blocks.en: C.2 Tokenizers and Projectors
blocks.zh: C.2 助推器和投影器

blocks.en: We adopt two tokenization pathways according to the structure of each sensory input.
blocks.zh: 我们根据每个感官输入的结构,采用两个符号化路径.

blocks.en: Pixel-aligned modalities. Depth, tactile, and thermal signals are represented as image-like inputs and processed using the default Qwen visual preprocessing. They are divided into patches by the pretrained visual patch embedding and then encoded by the shared vision encoder and merger.
blocks.zh: 像素相通模式. 深度,触觉,和热信号作为像图像一样的输入表示,并使用默认的Quen视觉预处理处理. 它们被被预先训练的视觉补丁嵌入后分为补丁,再由共享视觉编码器和并购来编码.

blocks.en: Non-pixel modalities. Point cloud, IMU, radar, motion, and smell inputs have distinct spatial or temporal structures that cannot be directly processed by visual patch embedding. We therefore introduce a lightweight tokenizer for each modality to map its native input into a sequence of embeddings with the same hidden dimension as the visual patch tokens. These embeddings are directly fed into the shared vision encoder and merger. The tokenizer design for each modality is described below.
blocks.zh: 非像素模式. 点云,IMU,雷达,运动,和嗅觉输入具有不同的空间或时间结构,无法由视觉补丁嵌入直接处理. 因此,我们为每种模式引入了一种轻量级的表示器,将其本土输入映射成一个嵌入序列,其隐藏维度与视觉补丁符号相同. 这些嵌入直接被输入到共同愿景编码和并购中. 每种模式的标致器设计如下:

blocks.en: C.3 Basic Modality Processing
blocks.zh: C.3 基本模式 处理

blocks.en: Unlike embodied sensory inputs, basic modalities retain the processing pathways inherited from the pretrained multimodal backbone.
blocks.zh: 与包含的感官输入不同,基本模式保留了从预先培训的多模式主干线中继承的处理路径.

blocks.en: Image pathway. RGB images are processed by the native Qwen3.5 visual encoder and merger. The resulting image tokens are directly inserted into the language sequence without an additional learnable projector, and the entire pathway remains unchanged during sensory training.
blocks.zh: 图像路径 。 RGB图像由原生的Quen3.5视觉编码器处理并合并. 由此产生的图像符被直接插入到语言序列中,而没有额外的可学习的投影仪,整个路径在感官训练期间保持不变.

blocks.en: Speech pathway. Speech signals are encoded using Whisper-large-v3-turbo ( Radford et al., 2023 ) . The resulting acoustic features are mapped to the language hidden dimension through a speech projector. The Whisper encoder remains frozen, while the speech projector is pretrained to align acoustic representations with the language model.
blocks.zh: 演说道. 语音信号使用Whisper-large-v3-turbo编码(拉德福德等,2023年). 由此产生的相声特征通过语音投影仪被映射到语言隐藏维度上. Whisper编码器仍然被冷冻,而语音投影仪则经过预先训练,使声调表达方式与语言模型一致.

blocks.en: Multimodal initialization. Before sensory training, UniSense is initialized from an image–speech–text instruction-tuned Qwen3.5 checkpoint, with its original image and speech pathways retained.
blocks.zh: 多式联运初始化。 在感官训练前,UniSense从图像-speech-text 指令-调取Qwen3.5检查点被初始化,其原始图像和语音路径被保留.

blocks.en: C.4 Sensory Representation Alignment
blocks.zh: C.4 感官表达方式

blocks.en: We provide additional implementation details for the sensory representation alignment stage introduced in Sec. 2.3 . Unless otherwise specified, the following settings correspond to the Qwen3.5-9B configuration.
blocks.zh: 我们为在Sec中引入的感官表达协调阶段提供更多的执行细节。 2.3 国家 除非另有说明,以下设置对应了Quen3.5-9B配置.

blocks.en: Conditional captioning. We use a lightweight 6-layer caption decoder with a hidden dimension of 1,024 1{,}024 and 16 16 attention heads. The decoder reuses the frozen token embeddings and language-modeling head of Qwen, while its remaining parameters are trainable. Cross-attention uses only the projected tokens of the target sensory modality as memory, and the decoder output is used solely for auxiliary caption reconstruction rather than the main response-generation pathway. The caption decoder remains trainable in both sensory-training stages.
blocks.zh: 有条件的字幕。 我们使用轻量级6层字幕解码器,隐藏尺寸为1,024 1{,}024和16个注意头. 解码器再利用被冻结的克文嵌入和语言模型头,而其所剩参数则是可训练的. 交叉意向只使用目标感知模式的预测符号作为内存,解码器输出仅用于辅助标题重建,而并非主要响应-生成路径. 字幕解码器在感官-训练阶段仍然可以训练。

blocks.en: Contrastive alignment. The projected sensory tokens and caption tokens are independently processed by the first k k frozen layers of the language backbone. In the default configuration, we use k = 8 k=8 . We apply mean pooling over valid sensory tokens and use the final valid caption token as the textual representation. The two representations are then passed through separate LayerNorm and linear projection heads, mapped to 512 512 dimensions, and ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -normalized before computing the symmetric InfoNCE loss.
blocks.zh: 相对相对相. 预测的感官符号和字幕符号由语言主干线上的第一个k k被冻结的地层独立处理. 在默认配置中,我们使用 k = 8 k = 8. 我们应用的是集合有效的感官符号 并使用最终有效的标题符号作为文字表示。 然后通过独立的LayerNorm和线性投影头传递这两个表示,映射到512个512个维度,和l 2\ell\2}——在计算对称的InfoNCE损失之前实现正态化.

blocks.en: Representations are gathered across all distributed workers to construct global in-batch negatives. Pairs corresponding to the same underlying sensory instance or sharing an identical normalized caption are excluded from the negative set to reduce false-negative supervision. The contrastive branch is used only during the first sensory-training stage and is disabled after the transition to modality-specific expert tuning.
blocks.zh: 在所有分布在各地的工人中,都收集了代表信息,以构建全球反差。 与同一基本感官实例相对应的对等或共享相同的正统标题均被排除在负数组之外,以减少假阴性监督. 对比分会只在第一个感官-训练阶段使用,在向模式特有专家调制过渡后被禁用.

blocks.en: C.5 Modality-Specific Expert Tuning
blocks.zh: C.5 模式 -- -- 特定专家

blocks.en: During the second sensory-training stage, modality-specific residual experts are activated in the selected full-attention decoder layers, while the pretrained self-attention and base FFN remain frozen. For the 9B model, expert modules are inserted into the eight full-attention layers at indices 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, and 31.
blocks.zh: 在第二个感官训练阶段,在选定的全意解码层中启动特定模式的残余专家,而预先训练的自觉和基地FFN仍然被冻结. 对于9B模型,在指数3、7、11、15、19、23、27和31的8个全意层中插入专家模块。

blocks.en: Expert configuration. Each embodied sensory modality uses an independent router and a pool of E = 3 E=3 residual experts. The router produces softmax weights over all experts in the corresponding modality-specific pool. Text, image, and speech tokens bypass these expert pools and retain the original pretrained FFN computation.
blocks.zh: 专家配置. 每个内含的感官模式都使用独立的路由器和E=3 E=3的剩余专家集合. 路由器在相应的模式特有池中产生对所有专家的软马克斯权重. 文字,图像,和语音符号绕过这些专家池,并保留原有的被预先训练的FFN计算.

blocks.en: Residual parameterization. Each expert applies low-rank residual adaptations to the gate, up, and down projections of the backbone SwiGLU FFN. We use rank r = 32 r=32 and scaling factor α = 64 \alpha=64 , corresponding to a residual scaling factor of α / r = 2 \alpha/r=2 .
blocks.zh: 剩余参数化. 每位专家对中枢SwiGLU FFN的上下预测进行了低等级的剩余适应. 我们使用正比分 r = 32 r = 32,而缩放系数 α = 64\ alpha = 64,对应的剩余正比分 α / r = 2\ alpha/ r = 2.

blocks.en: Regularization. We use router load-balancing together with z-loss regularization, with a combined weight of 10 − 3 10^{-3} . An additional expert-diversity objective is applied with a target weight of 0.07 0.07 , which is linearly increased from zero during the early expert-tuning stage to stabilize optimization.
blocks.zh: 规范化. 我们使用路由器负载平衡 与Z损失规范, 合并重量 10 - 3 10 - 3 。 采用了另一个专家多样性目标,目标重量为0.07 0.07,从早期专家调试阶段的零线上增加,以稳定优化。

blocks.en: C.6 Training Details
blocks.zh: C.6 培训细节

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, the following settings correspond to the Qwen3.5-9B configuration; the 2B model follows the same two-stage training procedure with scale-specific configurations.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,下列设置对应了"Quen3.5-9B"配置;2B模式遵循了相同的两阶段培训程序,并有"比例"特定配置.

blocks.en: Multimodal initialization. We construct a common multimodal initialization checkpoint before sensory training. We first connect a frozen Whisper encoder to the language model by pretraining the speech projector. We then perform image–speech–text instruction tuning, where the language model is adapted with rank- 64 64 LoRA while the speech projector remains trainable. No additional video-specific training is introduced during these preliminary stages. These stages establish the basic-modality pathways and are not counted as part of the two-stage sensory training of UniSense.
blocks.zh: 多式联运初始化。 在进行感官训练之前,我们建造了一个通用的多模式初始化检查站。 我们先把冷冻的Whisper编码器 与语言模型连接起来 预先训练语音投影仪 然后我们进行图像 - speech - 文本指示调试, 语言模式会按照级别调整 - 64 64 LoRA, 而语音投影仪仍然可以训练。 在这些初步阶段,没有进行专门的视频培训。 这些阶段确定了基本模式途径,不作为UniSense两阶段感官培训的一部分。

blocks.en: Two-stage training. Starting from the merged multimodal checkpoint, the pretrained language backbone and modality encoders remain frozen throughout sensory training. In the alignment Stage, we train the sensory tokenizers, modality projectors, caption decoders, and contrastive projection heads for 1 epoch using language-modeling, caption-reconstruction, and contrastive objectives.
blocks.zh: 分两个阶段训练. 从合并后的多模式检查站开始,经过预先培训的语言主干线和模式编码器在整个感官训练期间一直被冻结. 在对齐阶段,我们利用语言建模、标题重建、对比目标,为1个时代培训感官指示器、模式投影器、字幕解码器和对比投影头。

blocks.en: The tuning Stage continues optimizing the sensory tokenizers, projectors, and caption decoders, while activating the modality-specific routers and residual experts. The contrastive branch is disabled after the stage transition, whereas caption supervision is retained together with the expert regularization objectives. Stage 2 is trained for 2 additional epochs.
blocks.zh: 调制阶段继续优化感知指示器、投影器和字幕解码器,同时激活特定方式的路由器和剩余专家。 对比分支在阶段过渡后被禁用,而标题监督与专家正规化目标一起保留。 第二阶段为另外两个时代进行培训。

blocks.en: Loss configuration. During the alignment Stage, the caption and contrastive objectives are jointly applied with the language-modeling objective. We set the contrastive weight to λ con = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{con}}=0.5 and use an overall alignment weight of λ align = 0.08 \lambda_{\mathrm{align}}=0.08 for all modalities. In the tuning Stage, the contrastive objective is removed while caption reconstruction is retained. The router regularization is weighted by 10 − 3 10^{-3} , and the expert-diversity weight is linearly increased from 0 0 to 0.07 0.07 during the early expert-tuning stage.

blocks.en: All ablation experiments are conducted with the Qwen3.5-9B backbone. Unless otherwise specified, we keep the training data, modality tokenizers and projectors, optimization schedule, and evaluation protocol unchanged across variants.

blocks.en: Component ablation. We evaluate the contributions of sensory representation alignment and modality-specific expert tuning using the three configurations summarized in Table C13 . All variants follow the same two-stage training schedule. The baseline uses only the language-modeling loss on downstream instruction–response pairs during the alignment stage, followed by a single low-rank residual FFN shared across all sensory modalities without routing during the tuning stage(Fig. 7(a) ). We then introduce conditional captioning and contrastive alignment while retaining the same shared adaptation. The full model further replaces the shared residual FFN with modality-specific routers and expert pools.

We independently enable the two auxiliary objectives during the alignment stage, yielding four settings: (1) task LM only; (2) task LM with conditional captioning ( ℒ cap \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{cap}} ); (3) task LM with contrastive alignment ( ℒ con \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{con}} ); and (4) task LM with both objectives. blocks.en: Expert architectures. Starting from the sensory representation-aligned setting, we further examine how expert sharing affects the tuning Stage adaptation. We compare a Shared Expert Pool (Fig. 7(b) ), where all sensory modalities route over a common pool of 3 residual experts, with Modality-Specific Expert Pools (Fig. 7(c) ), where each modality uses an independent router and expert pool. Both variants start from the same representation-aligned initialization and retain the frozen pretrained base FFN.
